shelters.name: Yellowstone Valley Animal Shelter
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit opened 2009, now the largest animal shelter in Montana. Intakes over 5,000 animals annually, implementing industry best practices.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Western Montana
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing pet adoption, low-cost veterinary care, training and behavior services. Receives no government funding.

shelters.name: Lewis & Clark Humane Society
shelters.description: Ethically treats stray and unwanted animals. Offers programs to improve lives of rescue animals and provides shelter for pets involved in abuse cases.

shelters.name: Heart of the Valley Animal Shelter
shelters.description: No Kill Verified open admission shelter serving Gallatin and Madison Valleys. Accepts all cats and dogs regardless of condition or circumstance.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Northwest Montana
shelters.description: Focused on finding caring homes for orphaned cats and dogs and ending the destruction of healthy adoptable pets in the Flathead Valley.

shelters.name: Maclean-Cameron Animal Adoption Center
shelters.description: Established 2002, 100% nonprofit running entirely on donations. Fosters caring community through shelter, animal welfare advancement, and education programs.

shelters.name: City of Great Falls Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Ensures health, safety and welfare of domesticated animals and citizens through education about responsible pet ownership. Uses rescue partners and adoption events.

shelters.name: Beartooth Humane Alliance
shelters.description: Serving Red Lodge community for over 15 years with adoption services, reuniting lost pets, and affordable spay/neuter programs.

shelters.name: RezQ Dogs
shelters.description: Rescues abandoned and unwanted dogs primarily from Fort Belknap and Rocky Boy Indian Reservations in north-central Montana.

shelters.name: Pet Paw-See
shelters.description: Cat rescue focused on rescuing cats, providing medical care, educating the public, and finding forever homes.

shelters.name: Paws to Peaks Rescue
shelters.description: Adopts pointing breed dogs from shelters around Montana, provides loving care and retraining, finds rescue dogs forever homes.

shelters.name: Freckles and Tomcat Rescue
shelters.description: Food co-op and no-kill shelter in southeastern Montana providing food for foster pets and shelters. 100% volunteer-run.

shelters.name: Montana Pets on the Net
shelters.description: Statewide resource to increase adoptions of Montana pets held in shelters, humane societies, and rescue groups across the state.

shelters.name: Stafford Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving the Missoula area with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: Bitter Root Humane Association
shelters.description: Humane association serving the Bitter Root Valley in western Montana with animal rescue and adoption services.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Montana animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Yellowstone Valley Animal Shelter (opened 2009) is Montana's largest shelter with 5,000+ animals annually. Heart of the Valley is No Kill Verified. Coverage spans Billings, Missoula, Helena, Bozeman, Great Falls, Kalispell, and rural communities including reservation areas.
